raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#31340 added an FP8 Marlin fallback to `ModelOptFp8LinearMethod` for SM80-SM88. But `ModelOptFp8Config.get_min_capability()` still returns 89. The loader checks it before building any layer, so ModelOpt FP8 checkpoints never reach the fallback on A100 / A40 / A6000:

```
$ python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path nvidia/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8   # A40, sm_86
ValueError: The quantization method modelopt_fp8 is not supported for the current GPU. Minimum capability: 89. Current capability: 86.
```

## Modifications

- `ModelOptFp8Config.get_min_capability()`: 89 -> 80, matching `Fp8Config`.
- `ModelOptFp8MoEMethod`: raise a clear error on SM80-SM88. Marlin covers linear layers only, and no FP8 MoE backend supports these GPUs:
  - Triton can't compile FP8 (`fp8e4nv`) here.
  - FlashInfer CUTLASS has no SM8x build.

  Without this check, an FP8 MoE model such as `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-FP8` would crash during CUDA graph capture, about 9 minutes into startup. FP8 MoE on Ampere needs an FP8 Marlin MoE kernel, which is left for a follow-up.
- Docs: the compatibility table listed `modelopt_fp8` as SM90+. It now says SM80-SM88 via Marlin for dense models only, and native FP8 on SM89+.
- `test_modelopt_loader.py`: two regression tests.
  - One checks that ModelOpt FP8 loads on SM80/SM86 and is still rejected on SM75. Its SM80 and SM86 cases fail on `main`.
  - One checks that the FP8 MoE quant method raises on SM86. It fails without the new check.

## Accuracy Tests

1x A40, `sgl-eval run gsm8k --n-repeats 3 --temperature 0.6 --top-p 0.9 --max-tokens 4096` (full set, 3 repeats). The server was launched with default flags.

| Model | GSM8K |
|---|---|
| `unsloth/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` (BF16 reference) | 81.75% ± 0.90 |
| `nvidia/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8`, main | fails to start |
| `nvidia/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8`, this PR (Marlin + FP8 KV cache) | 81.65% ± 0.20 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

1x A40, `bench_serving --dataset-name random-ids --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 256 --num-prompts 200 --max-concurrency 16`, server with `--disable-radix-cache`, median of 3 runs:

| | Output tok/s | Median TPOT | Median TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|
| BF16 | 351.7 | 34.6 ms | 2447 ms |
| ModelOpt FP8, this PR | 417.4 | 18.4 ms | 4874 ms |

Decode is 1.9x faster. Prefill is slower because Marlin is weight-only and dequantizes to BF16 for the matmul.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

detail.title: [Fix] [NVIDIA] modelopt: Allow ModelOpt FP8 dense models on Ampere via Marlin

files.patch: @@ -149,10 +149,10 @@ The following table summarizes quantization method support across NVIDIA and AMD modelopt / modelopt_fp8 - Yes (Hopper/SM90+) + Yes (SM80-SM88 via Marlin, dense only; SM89+ native FP8) No No - NVIDIA ModelOpt; requires NVIDIA hardware + NVIDIA ModelOpt; requires NVIDIA hardware; use Marlin W8A16 fallback on Ampere (dense models only) modelopt_fp4

@@ -459,7 +459,8 @@ def get_supported_act_dtypes(cls) -> List[torch.dtype]:
 
     @classmethod
     def get_min_capability(cls) -> int:
-        return 89  # Minimum hardware capability (e.g., Hopper GPUs).
+        # SM80-SM88 have no FP8 tensor cores; linear layers fall back to FP8 Marlin.
+        return 80
 
     @classmethod
     def from_config(cls, config: Dict[str, Any]) -> ModelOptFp8Config:
@@ -1102,6 +1103,12 @@ class ModelOptFp8MoEMethod(FusedMoEMethodBase):
     """
 
     def __init__(self, quant_config: ModelOptFp8Config):
+        # FP8 Marlin covers linear layers only; no FP8 MoE runner supports SM80-SM88.
+        if can_auto_enable_marlin_fp8():
+            raise ValueError(
+                "ModelOpt FP8 MoE requires SM89+; on SM80-SM88 only dense "
+                "ModelOpt FP8 models are supported."
+            )
         self.quant_config = quant_config
         self.cutlass_fp8_supported = cutlass_fp8_supported()

@@ -36,6 +36,7 @@
 from sglang.srt.model_loader.loader import (
     DefaultModelLoader,
     ModelOptModelLoader,
+    _get_quantization_config,
     get_model_loader,
 )
 from sglang.srt.model_loader.weight_utils import (
@@ -962,5 +963,55 @@ def test_mixed_precision_resolves_vl_language_model_keys(self):
         )
 
 
+class TestModelOptFp8CapabilityGate(CustomTestCase):
+    def _resolve_quant_config(self, capability):
+        quant_config = ModelOptFp8Config.from_config(
+            {"quant_algo": "FP8", "ignore": ["lm_head"]}
+        )
+        model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            quantization="modelopt_fp8",
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            hf_config=PretrainedConfig(),
+        )
+        with (
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.model_loader.loader.get_model_architecture",
+                return_value=(nn.Module, "LlamaForCausalLM"),
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.model_loader.loader.get_quant_config",
+                return_value=quant_config,
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.model_loader.loader.get_device_capability",
+                return_value=capability,
+            ),
+        ):
+            return _get_quantization_config(model_config, LoadConfig())
+
+    def test_modelopt_fp8_loads_on_ampere(self):
+        """ModelOpt FP8 must load on SM80/SM86 via the Marlin fallback and stay rejected on SM75."""
+        for capability in ((8, 0), (8, 6)):
+            with self.subTest(capability=capability):
+                self.assertIsInstance(
+                    self._resolve_quant_config(capability), ModelOptFp8Config
+                )
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Minimum capability"):
+            self._resolve_quant_config((7, 5))
+
+    def test_modelopt_fp8_moe_rejected_on_ampere(self):
+        """ModelOpt FP8 MoE must fail at layer construction on SM86, not during CUDA graph capture."""
+        quant_config = self._resolve_quant_config((8, 6))
+        moe = FusedMoE.__new__(FusedMoE)
+        with (
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils.get_device_capability",
+                return_value=(8, 6),
+            ),
+            self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "SM89"),
+        ):
+            quant_config.get_quant_method(moe, "model.layers.0.mlp.experts")
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
